title: List of circuit gates
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers and let $f$ be a Boolean function on strings of length $n$. Define the gate list to consist, in order, of the gates at indices $0$ through $T(n,k)-1$, where $T(n,k)=c(n,k)+2^{n-k}$, $c(n,k)=f_0(n,k)+2^{2^k}$, $f_0(n,k)=z(n,k)+(2^{k+1}-1)$, and $z(n,k)=n+(2^{n-k+1}-1)$; all natural-number subtractions are truncated.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on length-$n$ Boolean strings
caveat: The snippet does not define the gate constructors used to specify individual gates, so their mathematical interpretation is unavailable.
